items.headline: GST collections jump 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October as festive demand beats high inflation and interest rates
items.summary: India's GST collections in October reached ₹2.31 lakh crore, reflecting a 22.9% year-on-year increase. Strong consumption trends are indicated by rising passenger car sales and record digital payments.

items.headline: India's festive demand is uneven as inflation, price hikes weigh on shoppers
items.summary: Summary While consumer demand remains resilient across consumer categories, demand shows signs of stress in pockets due to inflation from the West Asia war. items.headline: Australia TD-MI Inflation Gauge (MoM) rose from previous 0.3% to 0.5% in October
items.summary: The AUD/USD pair declines to around 0.7025 during the early Asian session on Monday. The US Dollar strengthens against the Australian Dollar amid elevated geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
